title: Budget and balance sheet
learning_outcomes: Explain financial stocks and flows in the context of budget and balance sheet.
Compare and distinguish budget and balance sheet in the context of budget and balance sheet.
Apply irregular expenses in the context of budget and balance sheet.
Evaluate and justify decisions about stress testing in the context of budget and balance sheet.

lessons.title: Financial stocks and flows
lessons.outcome: Explain financial stocks and flows in the context of budget and balance sheet.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving financial stocks and flows; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to fictional household budget.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain financial stocks and flows from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of financial stocks and flows; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving budget and balance sheet; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to fictional household budget.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain budget and balance sheet from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of budget and balance sheet; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.knowledge_check: Explain irregular expenses from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of irregular expenses; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Stress testing
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about stress testing in the context of budget and balance sheet.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving stress testing; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to fictional household budget.

lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of stress testing; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.

safety.notes: Draft educational framework only. Use fictional cases; no personal diagnosis, prescription, hazardous practice, financial/legal instruction or unqualified certification. Obtain qualified/local review before publication.
